ui_bugs.issue: QA prompt Section 2 explicitly requires /qa-qc and /training-hub. React-Router has /qaqc (no hyphen) and /training (not /training-hub). Console logs: 'No routes matched location /qa-qc' and 'No routes matched location /training-hub'. Hitting these URLs lands users on the SPA fallback (NOT a hard 404), but any external bookmark/email/printed-QR pointing at /qa-qc or /training-hub silently fails to render the intended page.

action_items: Add Route aliases: <Route path='/qa-qc' element={<Navigate to='/qaqc' replace />} /> and <Route path='/training-hub' element={<Navigate to='/training' replace />} /> (or rename actual routes to match the QA prompt spec). Either way, /qa-qc and /training-hub MUST resolve cleanly on production.

Re-verify Home-page EN/ES toggle clickably swaps page text — iter38 sniff showed body unchanged after click; could be a stale-selector miss on the testing side, but worth a 30-second manual confirm before redeploy.

rca of the issue: Routes registered in App.js use /qaqc and /training; QA prompt + tile copy reference /qa-qc and /training-hub. React-Router emits 'No routes matched location' warning and falls through to the SPA's NotFound/Home fallback. No backend impact — purely a client-side router map mismatch. Fix: add two <Route ... element={<Navigate replace .../>} /> aliases (or rename canonical routes to the hyphenated form and update internal links). Should be a 5-minute change.
